summary: Comprehensive testing of 'New Song from Audio' feature. All features working correctly: Dashboard 'From Audio' button present, modal opens correctly, API creates song from audio with transcribed lyrics and extracted duration, redirects to Song Editor with pre-filled data.
passed_tests: Dashboard - 'From Audio' button (green) exists next to 'New Song' (yellow)
Dashboard - 'From Audio' button has correct data-testid='create-song-from-audio-btn'
Dashboard - 'New Song from Audio' modal opens on click
Modal - Shows file input with data-testid='audio-song-file-input'
Modal - Shows 'Create Song' button with data-testid='audio-song-confirm'
Modal - Shows supported formats info (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, max 50MB)
API - Rejects non-audio files with 400 error
API - Accepts MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC extensions
API - Uses filename (without extension) as default song name
API - Returns 'audio_file' field with saved filename
API - Created song is retrievable via GET /api/songs/{id}
API - Created song appears in GET /api/songs list
Flow - After creating song from audio, user is redirected to Song Editor
Song Editor - Shows pre-filled song name from filename
Song Editor - Shows uploaded practice track with audio player
critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper file validation
Duration extraction uses mutagen library correctly
MongoDB _id is properly excluded from response
Error handling is in place for transcription and duration extraction failures
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ prefixed songs during testing (all cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: New 'From Audio' feature fully implemented and tested. Dashboard has two song creation options: 'From Audio' (green button) for audio-first workflow and 'New Song' (yellow button) for manual entry. The from-audio flow: Click 'From Audio' -> Upload MP3/WAV/etc -> System creates song with transcribed lyrics + duration -> Redirects to Song Editor. Filename (without extension) is used as default song name. Duration extraction and transcription may fail silently on invalid/short audio files but the song is still created.

from_audio_button.notes: Green 'From Audio' button present on Dashboard next to yellow 'New Song' button

from_audio_modal.notes: Modal opens with file input, Create Song button, Cancel button, and format info

api_endpoint.notes: POST /api/songs/from-audio creates song, extracts duration, transcribes lyrics

file_validation.notes: Accepts MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, AAC. Rejects non-audio files

redirect_to_editor.notes: After song creation, user is redirected to Song Editor with pre-filled data

song_editor_prefill.notes: Song name from filename, audio file attached, duration and lyrics if extraction/transcription succeeded
